name: secure-rbac-api-gateway-monorepo
description: Secure API Gateway with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Authentication, Authorization, Rate Limiting, and Security Monitoring

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api-gateway install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run start:frontend"
